description: Workshop agenda for "Siguria nga zjarri" contains Cyrillic ё instead of Albanian ë: "Mbretёrinё" and "Shqipёri".
steps_to_reproduce: Open homepage, scroll to Sunday workshops, expand "Siguria nga zjarri në ndërtesa banimi", read the agenda list.
expected: Agenda reads "Standardet në Mbretërinë e Bashkuar" / "Situata në Shqipëri" using Albanian ë.
actual: Renders with Cyrillic ё (visually near-identical in most fonts, but a different character; breaks search/copy-paste and screen-reader pronunciation).

description: Footer "Eksploro" column links to /#attendees but no element on the homepage has id="attendees".
steps_to_reproduce: Open any page, click "Pjesëmarrësit" in the footer.
actual: Navigates to a non-existent anchor; nothing to scroll to.

description: canonical link and og:url meta are hardcoded to the homepage URL on every page instead of the current route.
steps_to_reproduce: View page source of /visit-tirana/ or /asambleja/ and check <link rel=canonical> and <meta property=og:url>.
expected: canonical/og:url point to that page's own URL (e.g. https://global.illyrianbrains.org/visit-tirana/).
actual: Both always point to https://global.illyrianbrains.org/ regardless of the page loaded.

description: conference.heroImage ('/assets/hero-placeholder.svg') is never read by any component, and that file doesn't exist in public/assets/.
steps_to_reproduce: grep for heroImage in src/; list public/assets/.
expected: Hero.astro renders heroImage, and the README's "replace the placeholder hero image" step has an effect.
actual: Field and file are both dead; the README's instructions for swapping the hero image do nothing.

description: <main class="organizers-page"> has no matching CSS rule anywhere, unlike .landing-page/.visit-page which get card-stack section styling (overlap margin, rounded corners, z-index stacking).
steps_to_reproduce: Compare section transitions on / and /visit-tirana/ against /asambleja/.
expected: Sections on /asambleja/ stack/overlap consistently with the other two pages.
actual: /asambleja/ sections use plain default spacing with no overlap/stacking treatment.

description: program, speakers and attendees are exported but never imported anywhere; the real homepage copy for the same events is hardcoded separately in index.astro with different wording (e.g. Friday event: "Mbrëmje me pjesëtarë të rrjetit" in conference.ts vs "HappyHour i përbashkët" in index.astro).
expected: README claim "Most homepage content is in src/data/conference.ts" holds - editing it changes the site.
actual: Editing program/speakers/attendees has no effect on the rendered site.

description: Classes "friday-event" (Friday event card) and bare "venue" (on the venue-layout div) are applied in markup but have no matching CSS rule anywhere.
steps_to_reproduce: grep "\.friday-event" and a bare "\.venue " selector (not .venue-*) in src/styles/*.css.
expected: Either the classes are removed, or intended styles exist for them.
actual: Classes are inert leftovers with no visual effect.
